text: The Streamer Awards is an annual event dedicated to recognizing and celebrating live streamers, founded in 2022 by Twitch streamer QTCinderella to honor streamers, primarily within the Twitch community.[1][2][3] Nominees are chosen through an online fan vote,[4][5] and winners are determined by a weighted combination of the fan vote (70%) and a panelist vote (30%).[6][7][8] The awards show features two main segments: a red carpet event with interviews featuring nominees and internet personalities as they arrive,[9] and the main award ceremony where nominees are reviewed and winners are announced.[10][11] During the awards portion, musical performances are included.[12] Winners receive a trophy that depicts a Peepo, a variation of Pepe the Frog.[13] The Streamer Awards have established 50 award categories in total,[19] with the 2025 edition featuring 38 categories, 12 of which were not present in prior years.[20]
